title.narrative: Towards More Democratic and Peaceful Egyptian Society

description.narrative: The overall project goal is to contribute to building a more democratic and peaceful society in Egypt that embraces respect for human rights, pluralism, inclusiveness and tolerance. The main objective is to increase capacity of 200 young local community leaders in 4 governorates to promote and practice tolerance, peaceful coexistence, and active citizenship in their communities.
